ios.desc:
Whats the best device for reading? Phone? No, Tablet? Ummm maybe, But The best place to read and open PDFs is TV.
Upload your PDFs from Phone or PC, and View them on TV. Zoom with built in functionality and read all you want in holiday season With PDF Viewer TV.

More features like narration and account sync are coming soon.

quotes.text:
There are several options for the Apple TV [1]

There's probably something similar for Android TV.

Roku doesn't really have a third party app ecosystem
